title: A Knight Needs a Witness — Episode Studio rewrite
import: The Game → Create episode → Import ZIP. Preview before publishing a fixed version and assigning an exact class/date.
boundary: Don Quixote, Part I chapter 1 only; John Ormsby (1885). Existing fallback edition retained; no verified current weekly vocabulary list.

storyCircle.you: Student wants an answer worth sharing.
storyCircle.need: Find an account worth bringing home.
storyCircle.go: One question opens the journal; student lands in laundry.
storyCircle.search: Become a chronicler, negotiate a promise, examine books and helmet.
storyCircle.find: Grand names offer a satisfying heroic introduction.
storyCircle.take: Evidence threatens approval; chance can expose private notes.
storyCircle.return: Choose an introduction and reach the return-door quiz.
storyCircle.change: Separate reported actions, inferred motives and claims; answer the original question with limits.

motives.student: Bring back a worthwhile account; prior memory of being laughed at makes kindness personally meaningful.
motives.Quixote: Begin a useful, remembered life; believes chivalric models and names can organize his calling; fears reduction to a joke.

learningTargets: Diction and parody in the helmet passage
Names as constructed identity rather than achievement
Perspective and consent in the naming of Dulcinea

assets.prompt: Full-body transparent Don Quixote, lean older Spanish gentleman around fifty, grey moustache and pointed beard, dignified hopeful anxious expression; worn steel breastplate, brown clothes and boots; holding open helmet with pasteboard visor. Clean graphic-novel ink contours, warm flat colors, soft shading. Centered full body with margins, no text or scenery.
assets.normalization: Actual alpha checked, 240×370 transparent canvas, feet at y=360, aspect ratio preserved, WebP quality 88.

assets.prompt: Landscape 16:9 warm graphic-novel La Mancha courtyard around 1600: whitewashed house, open book-room doorway, table with paper and quill, laundry basket, fields beyond open gate. Clear central foreground, no people, text, weapons, windmills or modern objects.

assets.reuse: Classroom background and Mr. Hepting expression pack; original provenance retained.
